summary: New paint tool for the History workspace image mode: brush, eraser with the existing opacity slider, colour picker, Clear paint, Apply paint. Not decoration - a scribble is a shape reference for the models, and the flow the user wants is paint a rough shape, mask it, run detail over it. Reuses the MpiMaskStrip extracted by MPI-371; the new part is an RGBA paint layer kept independent of the binary mask layers, since masking the paint afterwards is the whole point. Apply flattens server-side like MPI-362 rather than round-tripping a 4K canvas as base64. Ships with MPI-376 - paint without undo is a demo.

maturity idea -> planned. tool spec is settled and it reuses the MPI-371 MpiMaskStrip. Board-wide re-stamp against the grown 10-value enum (todo gained research / needs-decision / blocked / deferred on 2026-07-31); every todo card had been sitting on idea or planned because those were the only values that existed when it was written.

Re-scoped by the MPI-424 brainstorm: this card now owns the BRUSH ENGINE, not just a paint tool - mask brush and paint brush are one engine with two destinations, extracted here. Also absorbs the alpha brush pack (originally MPI-401), which moved off MPI-382 when Adjust stopped being a strip control.

Resequenced THIRD (ahead of MPI-368). Alpha brush pack split out to MPI-435. Plan written; four design decisions settled with the user: dab-not-class extraction, per-entry persistence, procedural brushes deferred, paint is not a preview.
Implementation started. Third in the MPI-424 umbrella after the user swapped Paint ahead of Shapes.
Checklist derived from the compact plan: one stable Implementation step over the five plan items.

Plan items 1-3 done and USER-VERIFIED in the app: colour, undo, brush, eraser, clear, opacity. Shared dab + interpolation, PaintManager on the shared UndoStack, Paint rail group, destination-driven MpiMaskStrip, _isMaskTool split three ways. Items 4 (persistence + Apply) and 5 (docs) remain.

User caught a half-wire: MpiCanvasViewer._enterMode was a hardcoded mode chain, so paint fell through to activeMode=none and the tool was dead while looking alive. Fixed at the cause with a CANVAS_MODES set; the sweep also found the drop-stale-mode triple duplicated across both modechange subscriptions, now written once. Two guards added, negative-controlled. Suite 329 -> 336. Also fixed a PRE-EXISTING mask-brush bug: it stamped one dab per mousemove with no interpolation, so fast drags left holes - needs its own release-note line.

MPI-375 item 4 shipped and USER-VERIFIED: per-entry paint persistence (paint.png in the mask TEMP item dir, write-when-painted / delete-when-empty) and Apply through the new sibling route POST /project/apply-paint. mask-temp:delete narrowed to the three mask files so Clear mask cannot wipe the paint layer. Apply also honours the opacity slider on the user request - measured 0.75 -> 191, 0.5 -> 128 through the live route. Suite 336 -> 342, 8 negative controls. First app run failed on a STALE build, not code: main.js needs a restart, not a reload. Item 5 (docs) remains.
Item 5 ticked and the parent Implementation step closed - all five plan items are done. Docs only, no code changed: suite still 342/0 and git status shows only doc files plus this card workspace.

Item 5 self-verified. New docs/painting.md (170 lines, under the cap) covers the one-layer model, PAINT_MAX_EDGE 4096 vs the mask 1536, the shared dab and the skipping-brush bug it fixed, not-a-mask / not-a-preview, display opacity vs the layer-wide Apply bake, session-scoped per-entry persistence with the write-OR-delete rule and the mask-temp:delete narrowing, the sibling apply-paint route, the shared undo stack, and the MPI-435 / MPI-368 seams. Routed from BOTH docs/README.md and the CLAUDE.md Context Router. masking-undo.md enumerated set is now a two-layer table with the paint mutations plus the init-must-not-clear-twice rule. masking-tools.md taxonomy Paint row is no longer a forward reference. ONE UNRELEASED.md whatIsNew line - the mask-brush fix line was already in fixes from 7303d60e and was NOT duplicated. All 18 identifiers named in the new doc grepped back out of source.

maturity in-progress -> validating. Plan complete, validation.md carries the evidence for all five items; awaiting the user close. Plan drift recorded: item 5 said docs/masking.md was at its 200-line cap and it is at 129 - the separate doc still stands on the other ground, and docs/masking-tools.md (211) is the file actually over the line.

CLOSED, user-approved. Paint ships whole: PaintManager = ONE RGBA layer at image-native size capped at PAINT_MAX_EDGE 4096 on the SHARED UndoStack; brushDab.js = the extracted stampDab + strokeDabs both brushes now stamp, which also fixed a pre-existing mask-brush bug (one dab per mousemove, no interpolation, so fast drags left holes); MpiToolOptionsPaint + the Paint rail group with MpiMaskStrip made destination-driven; per-entry paint.png in the mask TEMP dir, written when painted and DELETED when empty, with mask-temp:delete narrowed to the three mask files so Clear mask cannot take it; Apply flattens server-side through POST /project/apply-paint honouring the opacity slider. Items 1-4 user-verified in the app across three rounds; item 5 was docs. Suite 342/0. Docs: docs/painting.md, routed from docs/README.md and the CLAUDE.md Context Router. Alpha brush pack was split out to MPI-435, now unblocked.
